_provenance.difference: Building flashtex-cli in the same cargo invocation unifies dependency features: libc gains `default`/`std` and the cc build dependency gains `parallel` (cargo tree -e features). The canonical engine build, `cargo build --release -p flashtex-engine` on its own (#1198), gives flashtex-initex ac65cc162300, the reviewer's; flashtex-cli on its own gives 9574b9c134e8. No flag or profile differs; the engine source is identical.
